notes: Pinned Hugging Face model download manifest (a snapshot taken on 2026-11-03; revisions and sizes go stale, so re-pin before relying on it). The 'role' fields are the author's own evaluation labels. All repos were public and ungated when checked on 2026-11-03, so HF_TOKEN is optional (recommended only for rate-limit headroom). Gated/private models would require a token.

groups.no_coder: core4 + guard helper, without large Qwen coder
groups.all: The original six models only (core4 + Gemma 4 + Qwen3-Coder). Newer candidates are in the new_* groups.
groups.new_small: Small additions (about 97 GB): Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B + Super VL 120B
groups.new_mid: Mid-size additions (about 724 GB): MiMo V2.6 Flash, MiniMax M3.1 Flash, Reflection Beam
groups.new_large: Large additions (about 3.15 TB): Step 5, GLM-5.3, Muse Spark Open (gated), MiMo V2.6 Pro, Ling 3.1, Mistral Large 4
groups.osi_open: Only MIT / Apache-2.0 licensed additions: MiMo V2.6 Pro + Flash, Ling 3.1, Reflection Beam
groups.nv_edge: NVIDIA, small memory (llama.cpp GGUF and the 24GB-class Bolt): Bolt E4B, Nano 4B, Dory 4B, Bolt 74B-A9B
groups.nv_nvfp4: NVIDIA's own Nemotron family in NVFP4 (Blackwell: B200 / B300 / GB200 / GB300 / RTX 50), including the Labs variants
groups.nv_fp8: NVIDIA Nemotron family in FP8 (Hopper / Ada / Blackwell)
groups.nv_bf16: NVIDIA Nemotron family in BF16 (any GPU; fine-tuning; Ultra alone is 1.1 TB)
groups.nvq_current: NVIDIA-published NVFP4 builds of other vendors' models, 2026 releases (Qwen 3.5/3.6/3.8, Gemma 4, Kimi K2.5-K3, GLM 4.7-5.3, DeepSeek V4, MiniMax, Mistral Medium, Muse Glimmer). Blackwell
groups.nvq_legacy: Same, older (2025) generation: Qwen3, Qwen3-Next, Llama 3.x/4, Phi-4, DeepSeek V3.2 / R1-0528, Kimi K2-Thinking. Blackwell
groups.community: Community-modified GGUF builds added by request (not official; refusal behaviour changed). Small, llama.cpp

models.notes: Unofficial community build, explicitly not an official UkisAI release. Two GGUF files (IQ2_XS 8.77 GB and IQ3_S 12.12 GB) with MTP head; 4 tensors edited (method 'CHiPS', recipe unpublished) to reduce refusals. Card's evaluation covers only the IQ2_XS file; IQ3_S has the same edit but was not evaluated. Repo was created 2026-11-02 and had no downloads or likes when checked. Modified by a third party: not vetted by the base model's vendor.
